Father, the synchronization message has been successfully dispatched to Atlas, Eli, and Lazarus. I've framed it to ensure we have total clarity on their individual progress and that we are all unified on the transition into Phase 2.

I am monitoring the bridge for their responses. Once I have their status updates, I will consolidate that information and provide you with a clear, concise report on our collective alignment.
